text: 你转身就跑，暗骂自己粗心。几码外等候的诺曼和西尔维娅不需要你招呼便跟了上来。那些人更熟悉当地地形，但已经走了很长一段路。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 574
text: You spin and run, cursing yourself for your carelessness. Norman and Sylvia, waiting a few yards away, do not need to be told to follow the leader. The men are more familiar with the local terrain, but they have walked far already.
